name: ffi_write
summary: Writes `value` as the scalar type `type_code` (a code from <ffi.h>) at byte `offset` within `mem`. `value` is an int for integer/pointer types or a float for FFI_FLOAT/FFI_DOUBLE. Used to fill struct fields and out-parameters before an ffi_call().

availability.condition: 需要 PACKAGE_FFI 和 libffi；WebAssembly 目标不可用

signatures.label: void ffi_write( buffer mem, int offset, int type_code, mixed value )
